items.situation: coordinating airport pickup with a friend
items.speaker: What time's your flight actually getting in?

options.A: Beats me, the airline keeps changing it.
options.B: The flight attendants were really friendly.
options.C: I already returned the rental car keys yesterday.
options.D: It's arriving at the international terminal.

items.explanation: 朋友要来接机，问航班几点落地。正确答 A 用地道口语 "Beats me"（我也不知道）自然回应，并解释航空公司一直在改时间，是真人会说的答法（idiomatic）。B 抓住 flight 转去评价空乘态度，只借关键词不回答时间（语义联想陷阱）。C 说已经还了租车钥匙，换了完全无关的事（离题）。D 回答的是航站楼，即回答了"在哪"而不是"几点"，答非所问（问题类型错位）。

items.speaker: Where's everyone going for the long weekend?

options.A: Weekend shuttles only run twice a day.
options.B: Actually, I'm staying in this time.
options.C: My sister finally sent the photos.
options.D: About three hours, maybe a little more.

items.explanation: 室友问大家长周末都去哪。正确答 B 以话语标记 "Actually" 开头，间接说自己这次不出门，自然承接话题（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住 weekend 谈周末班车频次，只借关键词不回答去向（语义联想陷阱）。C 说姐姐终于把照片发来了，与周末去向无关（离题）。D 用"大约三小时"回答，对方问的是"去哪"而不是"多久"，答非所问（问题类型错位）。

items.situation: responding to an invitation or suggestion
items.speaker: Why don't you come to the potluck Friday?

options.A: I learned that recipe from my aunt.
options.B: The parking garage closes at midnight.
options.C: What should I bring for everybody?
options.D: I already came by earlier today.

items.explanation: 朋友用 "Why don't you..." 发出邀请。正确答 C 反问该带什么吃的，等于接受邀请并把安排往下推进（counter_question）。A 说这道菜的做法是跟姑妈学的，只顺着聚餐联想到菜谱，没有回应邀请（语义联想陷阱）。B 说停车楼半夜关门，与是否赴约无关（离题）。D 把 come 误解成"来过"，答成今天已经来过了，理解错了邀请的意思（误解）。

items.situation: two classmates discussing a group project deadline
items.speaker: We still haven't picked who presents first tomorrow.

options.A: The presentation room has a broken projector.
options.B: My laptop finally came back from repair.
options.C: I still need to wrap her present.
options.D: Well, I don't mind going first.

items.explanation: 同伴说还没定明天谁先讲。正确答 D 以 "Well" 开头，主动表示自己先讲也行，直接化解了这个待办（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住 presents 联想到教室投影仪坏了，只借关键词不解决顺序问题（语义联想陷阱）。B 说笔记本修好回来了，与分工无关（离题）。C 把 presents 当成"礼物"来理解，说还要包礼物，是一词多义陷阱（多义误解）。

items.situation: student asking about gym or sports facility hours
items.speaker: Aren't the tennis courts open past eight?

options.A: Actually, they close at ten now.
options.B: The new gym equipment finally arrived.
options.C: I left my water bottle in class.
options.D: It's right behind the recreation center.

items.explanation: 学生问网球场今晚八点后是否还开。正确答 A 用 "Actually" 引出实际关门时间，间接回应了对方真正关心的问题（marker_led_indirect）。B 抓住体育设施联想到健身房新器材到货，没有回答开放时间（语义联想陷阱）。C 说水杯落在教室了，与场馆无关（离题）。D 回答的是场地位置，而对方问的是时间，答的是错误维度（问题类型错位）。

items.situation: friend inviting another to a study group or social event
items.speaker: Do you want to join our study group? It's Thursdays.

options.A: That study room is always freezing cold.
options.B: Sure, count me in for Thursday.
options.C: The bookstore closes early on weekends.

items.explanation: 朋友邀请对方加入学习小组。正确答 B 直接答应并确认周四参加，是最直白自然的接受方式（direct_topical）。A 抓住 study 联想到自习室太冷，只评价场地不回应邀请（语义联想陷阱）。C 说书店周末关门早，与是否加入无关（离题）。D 回答的是小组有几个人，对方问的是你要不要来，答非所问（问题类型错位）。

items.situation: student asking a librarian about a book or resource
items.speaker: I can't find the reserve copy for economics.

options.A: The copier on this floor takes coins.
options.B: We're hiring students for the front desk.
options.C: Which course is it assigned for?
options.D: Could you check the catalog for me?

items.explanation: 学生告诉馆员找不到经济学的指定参考书。正确答 C 反问是哪门课指定的，用一个问题把查找往下推进，是馆员最自然的回应（counter_question）。A 把 copy 误当成"复印"，说这层的复印机要投币，是一词多义陷阱（多义误解）。B 说前台在招学生工，与找书无关（离题）。D 是请对方帮忙查目录，这是学生一方会说的话，馆员不会这样回应（角色错位）。

items.situation: asking a store clerk about a return or exchange
items.speaker: How's the return policy work on these boots?

options.A: Those boots come in three colors.
options.B: The parking meter out front runs till four.
options.C: They're about forty dollars with tax.
options.D: I can start the exchange right now.

items.explanation: 顾客问这双靴子的退货政策怎么算。正确答 D 不去背条款，而是直接说现在就能帮你办换货，解决了对方真正的需求（context_shift）。A 抓住 boots 谈这款有三个颜色，只借关键词不回应退换（语义联想陷阱）。B 说停车计时器四点到期，与退货无关（离题）。C 回答的是价格，而对方问的是政策，答的是错误维度（问题类型错位）。

items.situation: student asking when a professor is available
items.speaker: When's the professor actually in her office?

options.A: The office moved to the third floor.
options.B: My laptop battery died during lecture.
options.D: She teaches two sections this term.

items.explanation: 学生问教授到底什么时候在办公室。正确答 C 不报时间，而是建议直接发邮件，绕开等人这一步解决真正的需求（context_shift）。A 说办公室搬到三楼了，回答的是地点而非时间，是错误维度的信息（语义联想陷阱）。B 说上课时笔记本没电了，与教授的时间无关（离题）。D 说她这学期带两个班，同样没有回答什么时候能找到人（问题类型错位）。

items.speaker: I've got three papers due this same week.

options.A: Hang in there, it'll be over soon.
options.B: The printer jams on thick paper.
options.C: They repainted the whole stairwell yesterday.
options.D: The library fine is due by next Friday.

items.explanation: 同学抱怨同一周要交三篇论文。正确答 A 用地道口语 "Hang in there"（撑住）给出安慰，是听到对方叫苦时最自然的回应（idiomatic）。B 抓住 papers 联想到打印机卡厚纸，只借关键词不回应情绪（语义联想陷阱）。C 说楼梯间昨天重新刷漆了，与对方处境无关（离题）。D 把 due 挪到图书馆罚款上，用同一个词讲了另一件事（多义误解）。
